checks_run: Immutable candidate inventory, type, and aggregate SHA-256 checks
Strict manifest/provenance parsing and direct provenance-file SHA-256 check
Copied-tree GCC 15.2.0 builds of the starter and sealed reference
Public, sealed-reference, adversarial, and intentionally incomplete starter test suites
GCC -fanalyzer and ASan/UBSan builds plus all three reference suites
Reviewer-authored 1 MiB boundary and inherited-signal-mask checks
Learner-facing make check invocation with the managed PATH
Manual review of correctness, progressive disclosure, provenance, licensing, pedagogy, and claim honesty
evidence: The reference and starter both built warning-clean from an isolated copy with the pinned GCC 15.2.0; -fanalyzer also exited 0.
The reference passed 11/11 public, 16/16 sealed, and 4/4 adversarial checks normally and under ASan/UBSan; the disclosed starter outcome reproduced as 2 passes and 9 failures.

A reviewer check blocked SIGINT before exec, ran a foreground sleep through a PTY, sent Ctrl-C, and received no prompt within 1 second; child_signal_defaults resets dispositions but never unblocks inherited masks.

A reviewer check showed that a newline-delimited command containing exactly 1 MiB before LF returns 2, while the same bytes at EOF return 0; the implementation counts the delimiter before enforcing the limit.
A containment probe observed descendant_alive=True after public_tests.run_command raised its 0.3-second timeout; ordinary harness subprocesses are not placed in or cleaned up by process group.
make -C starter check selected /usr/bin/python3 3.6.8 and all 11 tests errored on unsupported Python APIs, despite the pinned Python 3.11.5 being available outside PATH.

Metadata is internally consistent, PROVENANCE.json hashes to 8aa702b8b64241bda70f3a63e3d1b9a681e7dc87f4d5930b9b4f764f584e5dad, and the manifest conservatively remains GENERATED/PARTIAL with independent validation required and productionized=false.
The 41-file CANDIDATE tree had no symlinks or special entries and retained aggregate digest 466ca2eb284c88e7e4a5205ff605bcc4e4557422c04c8cfedd32bedaf029cc6c before and after review.
limitations: The immutable catalog baseline and linked external repository were not available, so source snapshot hashes, non-copying assertions, and the linked resource's NOASSERTION license could not be independently established.
No orchestrator-created learner view or transfer artifact was provided, so actual sealed-material exclusion and TRANSFER_VERIFIED status remain inconclusive.

Checks ran on one managed POSIX/Linux host; allocation/fork fault injection, cross-platform behavior, coverage-guided fuzzing, benchmarking, LeakSanitizer, and production readiness were not established.

The configured GCC and Python toolchains needed for review were available; other configured cross, Java, Node, Go, QEMU, assembler, parser-generator, and GLib toolchains were irrelevant and not invoked. rg and git were absent from the managed PATH but did not block review.
